sequenceDiagram
    title Checkout with payment retry
    autonumber
    actor Customer
    participant Shop as Checkout service
    participant Pay as Payment provider
    Customer->>Shop: Place an order
    activate Shop
    Note over Shop,Pay: All requests carry an idempotency key
    loop Until accepted or retries exhausted
        Shop->>+Pay: Authorize the card payment
        alt Approved
            Pay-->>-Shop: Authorization reference
            Shop->>Shop: Persist the order and reserve stock
        else Temporary failure
            Pay-->>Shop: Please retry later
        end
    end
    Shop-->>Customer: Order confirmation
    deactivate Shop
